title: Add a new user account
summary: Create a new user account with a home directory and set their password.

steps.explain: Create the user account, their home directory, and assign a login shell. Replace <USERNAME> with the desired name and <SHELL_PATH> with the path to the shell (e.g., /bin/bash).

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The name of the new user

steps.explain: Set the password for the new user.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The name of the new user

rollback.explain: Delete the user and their home directory.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The name of the user to delete

warnings: Ensure the shell specified in <SHELL_PATH> exists in /etc/shells, otherwise the user will not be able to log in.
